solution: The 'Sports' section says: "It was in 1983, that the Indian team won the World Cup for cricket, under the captainship of Kapil Dev. It was a historic victory." Sunil Gavaskar is the tempting rival because the very next sentence credits him — in the same year — with breaking the record for most test centuries, but that is a batting record, not the captaincy.

The 'Language' section says: "The English language has been gaining ground in India due to the process of globalisation which began after 1990. English is becoming the language of livelihood, as it opens the doors to multiple job opportunities." Hindi is the trap — the chapter does credit Hindi with uniting the country, but through Hindi movies, not through globalisation.
